titles.title: Crazy Day

description: Within a rectangular frame drawn on a white piece of paper, thin, plant-like forms spring up and intertwine with one another. Most prominent is a shape that resembles an iris flower erupting from the bottom of the page. The forms stand against a textured background filled with semicircular, organic shapes. The image has been rendered in shades of black and gray, with large expanses of exposed white paper incorporated into the composition.
imageCaption: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.
title: Crazy Day
